headline: Zacatecas Outlines 45,500 Million Peso Budget for 2027
summary: The Zacatecas state government plans a 2027 budget of 45,500 million pesos. It intends to direct more resources to security, education, health and rural development, and about 4,000 million pesos to public works.
why: State budgets set public spending on infrastructure and services. They influence regional demand for construction, contractors and local suppliers.
original_headline: Zacatecas perfila presupuesto de 45,500 millones de pesos para el 2027
